setup_walkthrough.what_happens: Price trades down into a discount array on the left side of the chart.
Price displaces upward, creating the first bullish fair value gap.
Price retraces back into a discount array of the current leg (overlapping breaker block and the FVG).
Price displaces upward a second time, leaving a new bullish fair value gap. This completes the mechanical 'displacement, retracement, displacement' ST sequence.
